title: Why can't I cancel my payment?
summary: This document explains why a payment can’t be canceled: the 17-minute cancellation window has passed, the recipient already claimed the funds, the transfer used an instant option and posted immediately, or a system action already finalized the payment. It also instructs to request a return, file a dispute from transaction details, and double-check recipient details; it advises canceling as soon as possible within 17 minutes.
faqs: Why is my payment cancellation option unavailable after a certain time?
